children: Q3 net sales were $433.0M versus $431.3M, and net earnings were $13.2M versus $12.8M. Nine-month sales fell 5% to $1,208.8M from $1,272.2M; net earnings increased to $38.3M from $37.7M.
Lower average pricing and sales volumes drove the decline, despite improved gross margin percentage.
Q3 net earnings rose to $13.2M from $12.8M
Profit increased year over year, supported by higher gross margin and lower administrative and financing expenses.
Quarterly sales were nearly flat year over year; the increase was largely due to product mix.
Nine-month gross margin rate rose to 11.3% from 10.6%
Improved cost-of-sales efficiency offset the effect of lower sales volume.
Nine-month net earnings rose to $38.3M from $37.7M
Earnings improved modestly despite the 5% decline in sales.

This is a quarterly earnings update showing modest Q3 growth alongside weaker year-to-date sales. Further results showing whether improved margins can offset lower pricing and volumes would determine whether the trend becomes a larger catalyst.
